text: S651 closed at the manual Windows elevation handoff. The maintainer approved running the official CAD setup; launch produced no targetable installer window, and three contemporaneous consent.exe processes are consistent with but not attributable to the installer. Please inspect any elevation prompt and approve only if it names the GetonAgain CAD setup; otherwise cancel. No install, pattern import, or receiver qualification is claimed. All V03 gates and holds remain unchanged; details: docs/research/epic17/S651-getonagain-install-contract/S651-exit-packet.md.
